specs.title: A real answered anterior quiz survives the posterior clinical marker and returns to the same question and explanation
The phone marker route reloads safely, retains newer writing, and falls back to the title after its explanation is hidden

Hint, explanation, hide and review actions focus their content and distinguish atlas progress from all cases
